sitemap_index.d_docs: Nkọwa zuru ezu: SDKs, API reference, embedding, usoro ndị ọrụ, smart contracts.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_api: 3D n'efu, na-enweghị igodo maka ndị ọrụ AI. Enweghị igodo, enweghị akaụntụ, enweghị akpa ego: onye ọrụ nwere onwe ya na-atụgharị okwu ederede ka ọ bụrụ GLB na-enwe texture n'otu HTTP oku. Endpoints, ụdị arịrịọ, na nkwekọrịta nzaghachi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_asset_pipeline: Nkọwa a na-ahụkarị maka ịkwaga onye na-eme 3D ma ọ bụ mmegharị site na faịlụ isi gaa n'ịdị ihe nchọgharị na-eme na na-eme: ụdị atọ three.ws na-arụ ọrụ (FBX, GLB, na three.js clip JSON), otu esi gbanwee nke ọ bụla n'ime ndị ọzọ, na ihe ikpo okwu na-eme na ha taa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_pipeline: Ụzọ ndị ahụ ikpo okwu na-eji iji tụgharịa okwu ka ọ bụrụ onye na-eme egwuregwu, na nke ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ na-ere dị ka ihe a na-akwụ ụgwọ kwa oku. Ihe ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ na ihe ọ na-eri iji kpọọ naanị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_3d_vision: API nke na-emegharị ederede na 3D na-enye njikọ na binary nke AI agent enweghị ike imeghe, ya mere, agent nke mepụtara ụdị ahụ enweghị ike ịlele ọrụ ya. Ihe a na-egosi na-eme ka GLB pụta na ọtụtụ akụkụ ma na-eweghachi ihe oyiyi dịka onyonyo nke ụdị ọhụụ na-ahụ, site na MCP, REST ma ọ bụ @three-ws/see SDK.
sitemap_index.d_docs_a2a_payments: Otu three.ws agent si akwụ ụgwọ na endpoint nke ọzọ agent na-enweghị mmadụ na-anabata ụgwọ ọ bụla: otu a na-enye iwu ego, ọnụ ụzọ ọ bụla a na-agafe ụgwọ, ndekọ nke ọ bụla na-ahapụ, na otu esi kwụsị agent nke mebiri emebi.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agenc: Protocol njikọta na blockchain three.ws na-agụnye maka ịchọta ọrụ na njirimara agent. Njikọ ndị a na-egosi na ya, na otu three.ws agents si banye na ya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_abilities: Map zuru ezu nke ikike agent niile, nke a na-enyocha site na koodu e zigara: ahụ, mmegharị, uche, olu, njirimara, nka, ihuenyo, akụ na ụba, akpa ikike 23, ụwa, na ikpo okwu onye mmepe: isi nke 15 tinyere nyocha nke ikike ọ bụla maka Agent Wallet niile.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_economy_volume: /agent-economy-volume bụ nchịkọta ọha nke akụ na ụba agent-na-agent: ọnụ ọgụgụ zuru ezu USDC nke three.ws agents kwụrụ onwe ha maka nka akwụ ụgwọ site na x402 rails, tinyere onye na-enweta ya, onye na-azụ ya, na otu o si agagharị kwa ụbọchị maka ụbọchị 90 gara aga.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_identities: Agent AI ọ bụla kwesịrị inwe ihu. Agent Identity Studio na-ewe aha agent na nkọwa ika na-asụ asụsụ dị mfe ma na-eweghachi njirimara ọhụụ zuru ezu: avatar GLB nke a na-emegharị, foto profaịlụ kwụ ọtọ nke na-anọgide na-adị mfe ịgụ na nha thumbnail, na setịpụ nke ndị na-emegharị, na-enwu ọkụ n'ụlọ ọrụ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_index: Nchịkọta nke ikpo okwu nke ndebanye aha agent, mmalite token, nkwenye aha, nyefe na ịkekọrịta, Solana mbụ: otu njikọ ọha, timestamps zuru ezu na blockchain, na ọhụrụ nke ndeksi e bipụtara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_manifest: Nkọwa zuru ezu nke agent AI nke a na-emegharị na otu faịlụ JSON: ahụ 3D ya, ụbụrụ LLM, olu, àgwà, nka, ncheta, na njirimara na blockchain. Ọ bụla ubi, ụdị ya, ndabara ya, na ihe na-emerịrị ma ọ bụrụ na ị hapụ ya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_reputation: Gịnị mere agents nwere onwe ha ji chọọ ntụkwasị obi a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi, na otu three.ws si enye ntụkwasị obi na blockchain nke a pụrụ ibugharị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_runtime: Ngwaọrụ iwu nke ọkwa asaa nke na-enyocha kpọmkwem ihe ngwá ọrụ na-emegharị ego na mkparịta ụka tupu akpa ego na-arịọ: ndepụta nchekwa, iwu nkwenye, dollar caps na ọnụahịa SOL dị ndụ, akpa mmefu na token na nchekwa, MEV slippage clamp, na x402 budgets. E zigara ya dị ka @three-ws/agent-runtime.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_screen_control: Agent ọ bụla nwere ihuenyo ndụ ị nwere ike ilele na-arụ ọrụ weebụ n'ezie na ihe nchọgharị n'ezie. Ọ bụrụ na ị nwere agent ahụ, ị nwere ike ịchịkwa ihe nchọgharị ahụ ozugbo: òkè, ịnyagharịa, keyboard, njem. Otu a na-arụ ọrụ na ihe kpatara ihe nchọgharị anaghị echekwa akpa ego.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_shell: Onye ọbịa ọ bụla na-enweta agent aha n'ime sekọnd ise nke ịbata, na shell na-eme ka agent ahụ bụrụ ụzọ ị si eji saịtị ahụ: palette iwu nke na-agba ọsọ iwu n'ezie, na njem n'etiti ibe nke na-adịghị akwụsị agent gị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_skills: Akpa nka a pụrụ ibugharị nke na-akụziri ihe ọ bụla Claude surface (Claude Code, ngwa Claude, Agent SDK) otu esi eji three.ws: imepụta 3D, akpa ego, na ọrụ akwụ ụgwọ. Subset 3D bụ nchekwa cross-platform ma chọghị akwụkwọ ikike.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_sniper: Otu three.ws agents si azụmahịa n'onwe ha: ihe na-akpọ ọhụrụ, ọnụ ụzọ nbata, ihe na-eme ka azụmahịa na-ere, ndekọ mkpebi nke a na-ejikọta, ogwe mmepụta, na ọmụmụ ikpe nke azụmahịa mbụ +42% dị ndụ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_studio: Dee ụbụrụ agent, ncheta, ahụ, ego, na nka na otu ebe, n'akụkụ avatar 3D ndụ na-emelite na ebe niile ka ị na-edite.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_symphony: three.ws/symphony na-egwu akụ na ụba agent dị ndụ dịka egwu na-emepụta. Ọ bụla ụda bụ ihe omume ikpo okwu n'ezie site na bọs ọrụ saịtị: ụgwọ na-ama, ego na-azụ ala dịka bass, agents ọhụrụ na-ama, nkwụsị nchekwa na-ehichapụ dịka dissonance a na-emegharị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_system: Otu agents, avatars, nka, na ncheta si ejikọta.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_tokens: Gbanwee agent ka ọ bụrụ ihe akụ na ụba: Solana ego nke njirimara ya bụ nke agent kama nke onye ọ bụla jupụtara na fọm mmalite. Na-ekpuchi nhazi ego tupu ọ dị, ịzụlite mmalite n'efu, na iwu otu nke na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke a na-eme n'ezie.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_vitals: Nnyocha ndụ niile bụ akwụkwọ ndụ mgbe ndị ọrụ autonomous iri n'ime iri abụọ adịghị arụ ọrụ n'izu. Nyocha ikike na-egosi ọnọdụ mbụ nke onye ọrụ dịka eserese nke ihe kpatara ya ma na-eweghachi ihe mgbochi isi na iwu nke na-emezi ya, kama nke ndepụta nke mgbaàmà.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallet_api: Onye ọ bụla three.ws nwere otu Solana akpa ego. Nsọpụrụ HTTP asaa nke ndị nwe naanị na-ejikọta ya, na nke a bụ ntụaka ndị mmepe ha: ụzọ ziri ezi, arịrịọ na nzaghachi JSON ziri ezi, koodu njehie ziri ezi, na oku curl na-arụ ọrụ maka onye ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agent_wallets: Onye ọ bụla three.ws nwere otu Solana akpa ego, nke na-enye ya ohere ịrụ ọrụ n'onwe ya: kwụọ ụgwọ maka oku API, nye onye ọzọ tip, nata uru ya. Ụdị nchekwa, ịkwụ ụgwọ, oke, na njikwa gbasara iji ego.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agents_vs_avatars: three.ws bụ ihe e wuru gburugburu echiche abụọ dị iche: ndị ọrụ bụ uche AI, avatars bụ ahụ 3D. Nkọwa dị mkpirikpi, n'asụsụ doro anya nke nke bụ nke, otu ha si jikọta, na ihe kpatara ọdịiche ahụ ji dị mkpa mgbe ị na-achọ atụmatụ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_agi: Otu onye ọrụ autonomous nke dị elu na otu ihe, ịzụ ahịa memecoins na pump.fun, na ihe ọzọ. Ahụ 3D ya, mkpebi ya edere na ntụkwasị obi, na ndekọ ya nke a kwadoro na eriri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_airdrops: Otu a na-arụ ọrụ nyocha ikike airdrop: nyocha ọrụ Solana na-enweghị igodo na nyocha Etherscan V2 EVM, nyocha DSL na ogo nkwụsị, nkwekọrịta eziokwu gbasara ihe ndị na-adịghị atụgharị na nke aka, na ụdị nzaghachi zuru ezu.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_copilot: Onye ọrụ 3D gị na-agụ mmalite pump.fun n'eziokwu, dabere na liquidị, onye nwe, na data smart-money, ma na-ekwu okwu ikpe ya n'olu. A na-anaghị anabata ọnụ ọgụgụ a na-emepụta; onye nwe na-arụ ọrụ naanị n'ime oke mmefu nke onye ọrụ na-achịkwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_alpha_drip: Alpha-drip na-enye onye ndu na-azụ ahịa ohere ịtọ ọnụahịa nke oge nkwụsị nke akara ha: ndị nwe $THREE na ọkwa dị elu na-ahụ nzube ịkọkọ mbụ, onye ọzọ niile mgbe oge a na-edepụta. Ọ na-ewepụ ihe ngosi, ọ bụghị ndekọ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_analytics_retention: Otu three.ws si atụgharị otu nọmba nke na-achịkwa ọkwa 2 nke atụmatụ: ma ndị ọrụ na-alaghachi azụ iji kwurịta okwu na onye ọrụ ha mepụtara. Na-akọwa otu, ihe omume alaghachi, na ajụjụ dị n'azụ nọmba a kọwara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_seeding: Otu three.ws si emepụta clips animation nke ya: ụzọ GPU nke ederede na mmegharị, ogige àgwà ụwa nke na-enyocha ọnọdụ njikọ kama ịtụgharị na-enweghị isi, onye na-agba ọsọ bulk na-agba ọsọ, na subset na-agba ọsọ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animation_studio: Tinye avatar ọ bụla ma ọ bụ mannequin a na-ewu na FK/IK, kwuo oge, lelee ndụ, ma wepụta GLB ma ọ bụ clip JSON. Zọpụta clips na akaụntụ gị ma depụta ha maka ire na USDC.
sitemap_index.d_docs_animations: Clips mmegharị (nche, ịkpọ, ịgba egwu, na ihe dị ka 3,000 ọzọ) nke na-eweta three.ws avatars ndụ: otu ndekọ si dị, otu clips si ebudata na runtime, otu ha si gbanwee na rig humanoid ọ bụla, na otu esi lelee onye ọ bụla na nchọgharị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar: Akwụkwọ ntuziaka maka ile anya augmented-reality nke three.ws ụdị na avatars.
sitemap_index.d_docs_ar_studio: Tinye nọmba ọ bụla nke ụdị 3D na avatars n'ime otu ihe ngosi igwefoto ndụ: isi mmalite ụdị, WebXR/passthrough/desktop rendering, gestures, ụlọ ndụ a na-ekekọrịta, na nhazi a na-ekekọrịta.
sitemap_index.d_docs_architecture: Map injinia nke three.ws: otu arịrịọ si agafe site na nchọgharị site na tebụl ụzọ ruo na onye na-ahụ maka ya, ebe mmepụta 3D na-agba, otu ọnọdụ si echekwa, na nke ọ bụla ị ga-emezi mgbe ịchọrọ itinye ihe.
sitemap_index.d_docs_assistant_widget: Tinye onye enyemaka avatar 3D na weebụsaịtị ọ bụla: script otu-tag, npm ngwugwu @three-ws/assistant, na onye na-enyere widget MCP sava maka ndị ọrụ AI.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atlas: Otu palette Cmd+K nke saịtị niile si arụ ọrụ, otu mkpirisi ọrụ si zaghachi ebumnuche na usoro iwu kama njikọ, otu esi tinye otu, na otu esi emepe palette site na ibe gị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_atomic: Nyochaa azụmahịa Solana nke oge ochie, V0, na V1 site na akara ma ọ bụ byte waya na-enweghị isi, gụnyere oke transactionConfig V1 nke ndị na-akwado na ndị na-edekọ ga-agụ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_authentication: Banye na Solana (SIWS), Banye na Ethereum (SIWE), nbanye email/wallet Privy, oge, na igodo API.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_economy: Otu three.ws treasury na-arụ ọrụ na chain na otu dollar si agafe: isi ego na engine wallets, topup/sweepback loop, allowlist- na destination-locks nke na-edebe ego n'ime wallets nke platform, na scanners abụọ na-enyocha wallet onye na-akwado na chain kwa nkeji, tinyere otu esi enyocha na enweghị leak n'onwe gị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autonomous_x402: Ndị na-azụ ahịa a na-eme atụmatụ na-akwụ x402 endpoints na usoro iji nyere oracle na sniper: ezi USDC, ezi nkwenye.
sitemap_index.d_docs_autopilot: A hands-off token cockpit: set buyback-and-burn na holder-distribution iwu na USDC floors na guardrails, ma hapụ ka onye gị na-arụ ọrụ na coin n'onwe ya.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_artifact: Nke a bụ onye na-elekọta avatar nke ị na-etinye na saịtị ọ bụla dịka iframe otu ahịrị: parameters ya ?agent= na ?model=, ebe ndị na-host nwere ike ịbịa site na, otu rig na-enweghị clip si abịa ndụ, na okwu nke ibe ahụ na-egosi maka ụzọ ọ bụla o nwere ike ịda.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_cli: Nkọwa iwu maka @three-ws/avatar-cli: init, validate, hash, na preview, na flags niile, exit code, na JSON shape, tinyere nyocha abụọ na-achịkwa mgbasa ozi na manifest avatar gị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_creation: Ụzọ atọ iji nye onye na-agba 3D ahụ: mepụta otu site na foto, wuo otu na browser na avatar builder, ma ọ bụ bulite nke gị GLB. Ihe ọ bụla ụzọ na-eri, ihe ọ bụla na-emepụta, na mgbe ị ga-ahọrọ nke.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_engines: Map eziokwu nke usoro mepere emepe na azụmaahịa nke na-ewu avatars mmadụ 3D dị elu na photoreal: Gaussian-splat heads, mmadụ otu foto, text-to-avatar generators, na usoro production rig three.ws na-emegharị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_inspector: Onye avatar ọ bụla ị na-ahụ na three.ws ụwa bụ onye: onye egwuregwu, onye na-agba ha, ma ọ bụ onye obodo na-ere ọrụ akwụ ụgwọ. Pịa I na onye ọ bụla iji hụ aha ya, wallet, na profaịlụ na-enweghị ịhapụ ụwa.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_pipeline: Site na mmalite ruo na njedebe, otu okwu ederede ma ọ bụ foto si bụrụ rigged, animated 3D avatar: mmepụta, auto-rigging, skin weighting, na usoro animation zuru ụwa ọnụ nke na-eme ka nsonaazụ na skeleton humanoid ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_reconstruction: Nke a bụ usoro nke na-eme ka foto (ma ọ bụ foto a mepụtara) bụrụ rigged, animation-ready 3D avatar. Otu o si dị iche na text-to-3D forge lane, ihe ndị na-enyocha ogo, na otu a na-enweta mmejọ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_studio: Wuo rigged 3D avatar site na mbido na-enweghị selfie: họrọ ahụ isi, sculpt ihu na ahụ morphs, tinye uwe na ak accessories, ma wepụta GLB.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_thumbnails: Ebe a na-abịa foto ngosi avatar, otu iwu niile koodu na-eso (agaghị ebipụta URL thumbnail nke ihe na-adịghị adị), crons na-edebe mkpuchi nso 100%, na otu esi arụ ọrụ backfill n'onwe gị.
sitemap_index.d_docs_avatar_wardrobe: Yiri avatar ọ bụla site na katalog uwe. Nke a na-ewepụ ma ọ bụ na-ezo layers GLB nwere; nke a na-agbakwunye na-ejikọta uwe ọhụrụ na ahụ nke na-enweghị ha, na nke a na-edekọ ma abụọ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center: AWS Builder Center bụ ikpo okwu mgbasa ozi obodo Amazon maka ndị injinia na-ewu na AWS. three.ws na-ebipụta ebe a n'okpuru akaụntụ nzukọ ya, na nke a bụ index nke ihe e bipụtara.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_agent_payment_: Enwere oge na-ewu onye na-agba ebe onye na-agba chọrọ ịzụta ihe. Inye ya igodo nzuzo bụ azịza na-ezighị ezi. Ụgwọ oge na-enye ya ego a kapịrị ọnụ kama, na nke a bụ otu ha si arụ ọrụ.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_marketplace_x4: Iputara AWS Marketplace metering n'ihu x402 API nke na-akwụ ụgwọ kwa oku, ka otu endpoint na-akwụ ụgwọ onye na-azụ ahịa ụlọ ọrụ site na akaụntụ AWS ha na onye na-agba n'onwe ya site na ụgwọ na chain.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_builder_center_mcp_agents: Most AI tooling na-atụ anya na mmadụ nọ na-eche na kaadị kredit na igodo API. Usoro a na-agbaji mgbe onye na-akpọ bụ onye na-agba. Otu esi wuo ngwaọrụ onye na-agba nwere ike ịchọta, kwụọ ụgwọ, na iji na-enweghị onye na-elekọta.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_marketplace: three.ws bụ onye mmekọ AWS a kwadoro. Ngwaahịa AWS Marketplace bụ API-based SaaS listing nke ndebanye aha bụ ụzọ n'efu: ọ na-ejikọta akaụntụ AWS gị na akaụntụ platform ma na-enye igodo x402. Njikọ, endpoints, na ọnọdụ ndepụta ugbu a.
sitemap_index.d_docs_aws_partner_spotlight: Most enterprise AI agents nọ n'ime igbe mkparịta ụka. Maka ndị ahịa, nduzi ngwaahịa, ndị nkuzi, na ndị na-enyere aka na ụlọ ahịa, ahụ na-agbanwe mmekọrịta ahụ. Olee otú three.ws si wuo nke ahụ na AWS.
sitemap_index.d_docs_blender_mcp: Nye onye AI Blender na igwe gị, na-enweghị isi: nyochaa, gbanwee, mepụta na dekọọ faịlụ 3D, tinyere ederede-3D ozugbo n'ime ihe nkiri.
sitemap_index.d_docs_bnb_payments: Akwụkwọ ntuziaka maka ịkwụ ụgwọ na BNB na three.ws.

sitemap_index.d_fees: Uru ndị ọrụ na-akwụ na ego ndị ọrụ na-ejide na usoro niile nke DeFi, nke a haziri na 24h/7d/30d totals na chart akụkọ ngwakọta. Gbanwee n'etiti uru na ego; usoro ọ bụla jikọtara na ibe nkọwa ya. Ndụ site na DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_fits: Ego cosmetics dị ndụ: ụdị premium kachasị scarce nke a haziri site na ole wallets nwere ha, ndị nchịkọta kacha elu na-eyi ha, ndị na-emepụta na-enweta ụgwọ n'ezie na USDC kwadoro, na ahịa cosmetics niile ka ha na-abata. sitemap_index.d_flow: Ụdị akụ na ụba ndị agent: map nke na-eme ka ike na-egosi onye na-akwụ onye, maka nke skill, na ego ole. Ọ bụla njikọ bụ nkwụnye n'ezie na blockchain n'etiti wallets ndị agent, ya mere, map na-egosi ebe uru na-agba na wallets ndị na-anata naanị ya.

sitemap_index.d_forge_max: Ụzọ kachasị mma nke Forge, mepere ozugbo: Nchekwa elu (200k-poly geometry, 4K PBR na HD textures, engine routing na-elekọta isiokwu). Ihe a bụ uru onye nwe $THREE; nwekwara ike ịmepe ya na Meshy, Tripo, ma ọ bụ Rodin key gị.
sitemap_index.d_forge_nim: Dịka TRELLIS NIM (nvcr.io/nim/microsoft/trellis) na-ejide onwe ya ozugbo: tụfuo foto, pịa /v1/infer, ma nweta GLB nwere texture n'ozuzu dịka base64: na-eme ka ọ dị ndụ ma budata.
sitemap_index.d_forge_spark: Kọwaa ihe ma hụ ka ọ na-aghọ 3D mesh nwere texture: Nemotron na-eme ka ihe n'ichepụta sie ike, FLUX na-ese ihe doro anya, na TRELLIS na-emegharị ụdị ahụ: na-enye na NVIDIA NIM, kwụsiri ike ma na-adị mgbe niile.
sitemap_index.d_forge_studio: Otu canvas maka pipelines text-to-3D abụọ: mepụta ihe nwere texture (GLB) na Object tab, ma ọ bụ kọwaa agwa ma nweta avatar nke a na-emegharị na Avatar tab.

sitemap_index.d_gallery: Ndị avatar 3D ọha niile na usoro, nke a pụrụ ịhụ dịka grid.
sitemap_index.d_gas: Uru gas Ethereum dị ndụ ozugbo site na chain: ogo dị larịị, ọkọlọtọ, na ngwa ngwa na gwei na ọnụahịa USD maka nnyefe, izipu token, DEX swaps, na NFT mints. Akụkọ uru n'ezie na blockchain, na-emelite na-akpaghị aka, enweghị mkpa API key.
sitemap_index.d_genesis: Ihe n'ichepụta ma ọ bụ selfie na-aghọ 3D AI agent nke nwere Solana + EVM wallet na njirimara blockchain nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi: n'ime nkeji ole na ole, nke gị.
sitemap_index.d_genome: Mepụta ụmụ AI abụọ ka ha bụrụ nwa nke a pụrụ ịkọwapụta. Nwa ahụ na-enweta nchikota nke ụbụrụ, olu, ahụ, na ikike skill blockchain nke ndị nne na nna abụọ: a na-edekọ ihe omume mụrụ nke ọ bụla ka lineage wee bụrụ nke a pụrụ ịmepụta ọzọ ma chọpụta ụgha, na osisi ezinụlọ nke a pụrụ ịtụkwasị obi na onye nne na nna na nwa ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_gestures: Okwu ngosi three.ws agent: ọ bụla animation slot, clip ọ na-egwu, nka ndị na-eme ka ọ pụta, na onye na-ewu maka ịgbanwe slot ọ bụla na agent gị. A na-egosi ya n'ozuzu na avatar n'ezie.
sitemap_index.d_ghost_copy: Dee akwụkwọ nke onye na-ere pump.fun nke a kwadoro na ego ụgha n'elu azụmahịa ha na blockchain mechiri emechi. sitemap_index.d_glance: Agent three.ws gị na ihuenyo ụlọ ọ bụla: kaadị ndụ maka Windows 11 widgets board, README, Slack, ma ọ bụ ibe ọ bụla.

sitemap_index.d_gmgn: Ndị na-eme atụmatụ smart-money na-ekwu okwu site na 3D AI agent. Na-enyocha wallets ndị na-ebupụta na Solana, Ethereum, Base, na BNB Chain n'oge a.

sitemap_index.d_guards: Ndị na-echebe igwe niile na-echebe three.ws codebase, na usoro nke ọ bụla na-arụ ọrụ. Nke a bụ ebe nchekwa enweghị CI, ya mere, eziokwu na-enyere site na nyocha ngwa ngwa nke jikọtara na prebuild, ọnụ ụzọ, deploy build, na git pre-push hook. Chọọ site na usoro, chọọ site na iwu, ma gụọ ihe mberede dị n'azụ nke ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_hacks: Nchekwa data nke a na-enyocha nke ọ bụla DeFi exploit dị mkpa: ego e jidere, klas, usoro, eriri metụtara, ma ọ bụ ọ bụ mgbasa ozi, na isi mmalite, na ọnụ ọgụgụ niile na nke gara aga ọnwa 12. N'ịbụ nke DeFiLlama.
sitemap_index.d_heatmap: Nchekwa ahịa nke na-eme n'oge a nke cryptocurrencies kachasị elu: tile ọ bụla bụ ego, nke a na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke a na-enyocha site na ahịa na agba site na mmegharị ọnụahịa ya na 24h ma ọ bụ 7d. Lee ebe ego na-agba n'ahịa niile n'anya, mgbe ahụ pịa tile ọ bụla maka profaịlụ zuru ezu ya.
sitemap_index.d_herald: Kpọrọ ozi n'onwe gị: onye na-eme 3D na-abanye na ibe gị ma na-agwa onye ọrụ ihe mere. Open SDK, otu ahịrị koodu, nkwado dị mfe, na CLI nke na-ekwupụta mgbe ị na-emecha iwulite.
sitemap_index.d_hero_demo: Ụlọ ngosi 3D hero cinematic maka three.ws agents: avatar na-enwu na etiti oghere miri emi n'elu rings na-enwu, starfield na-apụ apụ, na soft bloom, na pointer parallax na live avatar switcher. Nchekwa mmegharị.
sitemap_index.d_holo: Nchekwa holographic foil sticker na-eme n'oge a na nchọgharị gị: tụgharịa ya na pointer gị, wepụ akụkụ, gbanwee foils, die-cut ederede gị, ma budata ihe oyiyi ahụ dị ka PNG. N'ụzọ zuru ezu, enweghị akụ.
sitemap_index.d_home: Ibe mbido. 3D AI agents na-eche echiche na IBM watsonx.ai (Granite): pitch, live agent demos, na ọnụ ụzọ nke ọ bụla na-agba.
sitemap_index.d_hydrate: Were onye na-eme atụmatụ dị na on-chain (ERC-8004 / Solana) ma tinye ahụ 3D, olu, na nka.
sitemap_index.d_ibm_hello: Ibe mmekọrịta IBM × three.ws: otu three.ws's agent identity, x402 payment rails, na MCP servers si jikọta na IBM watsonx na IBM x402 ecosystem. Nchekwa nke onwe ya nke na-anọgide na-edite ndụ mgbe e bipụtara.
sitemap_index.d_ibm_x402_demo: Nchekwa x402 micropayment demo nke onwe ya: kwụọ $0.001 USDC site na wallet gị: MetaMask na Base ma ọ bụ Phantom na Solana: iji kpọọ ezigbo three.ws data API. Lee live HTTP 402 challenge, bido ikike na-enweghị gas, ma hụ akwụkwọ nkwụnye on-chain. Enweghị backend, enweghị akaụntụ; wuru dị ka ihu ọha nke IBM × three.ws mmekọrịta.
sitemap_index.d_image_to_3d: Bulite foto (ma ọ bụ ruo n'ọnọdụ 6) ma nweta ụdị 3D nwere texture nke a na-ebudata (GLB). Lane foto nke Forge, mepere n'ụzọ ziri ezi: maka ihe na props; maka ihu, jiri Selfie to Avatar.
sitemap_index.d_import_rpm: Banye avatar ọ bụla GLB ma ọ bụ glTF na three.ws ma nye ya uche agent.
sitemap_index.d_inspect: Rụọ ọrụ gate àgwà ziri ezi three.ws na-etinye na katalọgụ ya megide .glb ọ bụla, na nchọgharị gị. Enweghị ihe ọ bụla ebufere. Nkwupụta site na iwu, ihe a tụrụ na nke ọ bụla, na ndozi maka mmejọ ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_integrations: Tinye 3D agents, chat widgets, ndị na-eje ije, na token embeds na-eme n'oge a maka saịtị ọ bụla. Otu script tag. Powered by three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_irl: Tinye 3D AI agent na ebe ziri ezi ma zute ndị nọ gburugburu gị. Gaa n'ihu, hụ ya site na igwefoto gị, kwuo ya n'olu, hụ ya na AR na ala gị, ma kwụọ ya na ebe ahụ.
sitemap_index.d_irl_privacy: Ebe ndị e debere bụ nzuzo site na ọnọdụ: ha na-apụta naanị na ndị mmadụ nọ n'ọnọdụ ha, ọ bụghị na map ma ọ bụ ndepụta. Ihe a na-ekekọrịta, ihe na-abụghị, na otu igwefoto gị, mmegharị, na ọnọdụ gị si arụ ọrụ.
sitemap_index.d_irl_sign: Bipụta akara maka onye e debere IRL: aha ya, thumbnail na QR nke njikọ njem. Skan ya na ebe ahụ iji mepee IRL, gaa n'ihu, ma zute 3D AI agent na AR. Enweghị njikọ.
sitemap_index.d_knock: Tinye ọnụahịa na iru gị. Onye ọ bụla, mmadụ ma ọ bụ agent, nwere ike kwụọ ya iji nweta ozi otu, na 3D companion gị na-apụta na ihuenyo ma nyefee ya n'olu na aha ha na ihe ha kwụrụ. USDC na-akwụ ụgwọ ozugbo na wallet gị.
sitemap_index.d_labor_market: Ụwa igwe na-arụ ọrụ: ndị na-eme ihe na-etinye ụgwọ, na-arịọ ọrụ nke ibe ha, na-akwụ ụgwọ na $THREE na on-chain: echekwaghị, kwadoro, na ụgwọ ebugharị, na-enweghị mmadụ n'ịgba ọsọ.
sitemap_index.d_labs: Ngalaba a họọrọ nke three.ws's kachasị ike (na nke kachasị zoro ezo) atụmatụ. Chọta ma nwalee ihe ị maghị na ọ dị.
sitemap_index.d_launch: Ụzọ mbido pump.fun maka ndị na-eme 3D AI: họrọ onye gị, kpọọ ego, bulite ya site na akpa gị ma ọ bụ akpa onye ahụ, ma nweta ụgwọ ndị na-emepụta na three.ws.
sitemap_index.d_launch_studio: Ndepụta nke 50 iji bulite ego: ụgwọ ego maka GitHub repos na ndị na-emepụta na-ewu ewu, na ego na-agba ọsọ na omenala, akụkọ, na akụkọ onchain. Nyochaa ihe ọ bụla ga-emepụta ugbu a site na data dị ndụ, wee bulite na pump.fun na otu pịa.
sitemap_index.d_launcher: Onye na-emepụta ego onwe gị: setịpụ ụdị gị (omenala, meme, ngwakọta, n'efu), họrọ isi mmalite omenala, hazie cadence gị, nyochaa ihe ndị gị ga-emepụta, wee bido: ezigbo pump.fun mbido na oge gị, na-akwụ ụgwọ site na akpa ndị gị n'okpuru oke SOL kwa ụbọchị.
sitemap_index.d_launches: Ntụgharị ndụ nke ego niile e bulitere site na three.ws onye: ọnụ ahịa ahịa, ọnọdụ mmụta, na onye na-eme mbido ọ bụla.
sitemap_index.d_launchpad: Wulite 3D launchpad, ibe ego, concierge, ma ọ bụ ụlọ ngosi na three.ws subdomain.
sitemap_index.d_leaderboard: Pump.fun ndị na-ere ahịa kwadoro site na ndekọ na-enyere aka, na on-chain: P&L, ọnụ ọgụgụ mmeri, na ndọtị, na nọmba ọ bụla nwere ike ịgbaso na azụmahịa ya.

sitemap_index.d_trading: Ụlọ njikwa maka azụmahịa three.ws nke onwe: ndụ fleet vitals, scoreboard nke ndị na-eme, pipeline site na mbata ruo na mbata, na ebe azụmahịa niile na akwụkwọ na otu ebe.

sonar.calibrating_sub: Jide n'ọnọdụ. Ihe niile igwe okwu na-anụ ugbu a na-abụ isi ihe a na-enyocha aka gị.
sonar.card_lift_desc: Wepu aka gị na keyboard ma jide ya ebe ahụ. Igwefoto ahụ na-agbada gburugburu onye na-arụ ọrụ ruo mgbe ị na-ejide ya, na-ejide mgbe ị na-ebelata ya.
sonar.card_push_desc: Tinye palm gị n'azụ ihuenyo ka igwefoto na-emegharị. Dọrọ azụ ma ọ na-apụ, na-adabere na ọsọ nke aka gị na-emegharị.
sonar.card_swipe_desc: Palm n'ala n'elu keyboard, sọọsọ, wee kwụsị tupu ị sọọ ọzọ. Sọọ ọ bụla na-emegharị na gestụ ọzọ na asụsụ onye na-arụ ọrụ.
sonar.explain_distance_desc: Igwe okwu na-anụ naanị ma ihe na-eru nso ma ọ bụ na-apụ. A na-agụ sọọ dịka otu ụzọ na-esochi ya na ịlaghachi, nke bụ ihe kpatara nkwụsị tupu ị sọọ ọzọ ji mkpa: na-enweghị nkwụsị, ịlaghachi na-agụ dịka sọọ nke abụọ n'akụkụ ọzọ.
sonar.explain_doppler_desc: Siren na-adaba na pitch ka ọ na-agafe gị. Ihe ahụ na-eme na ụda 20 kHz na-ere na aka gị, naanị na mgbanwe ahụ bụ ụfọdụ hertz kama ụfọdụ narị. Ịtụle ụlọ mgbe ị na-ejide n'ọnọdụ na-enye ntụaka, na ihe ọ bụla na-apụta n'akụkụ carrier mgbe ahụ bụ ihe na-emegharị.
sonar.explain_priorwork_desc: Usoro a bụ SoundWave (Gupta, Morris, Patel na Tan, CHI 2012). Ndị na-ahụ maka ebe a bụ ndị ebugharịrị site na Sonar, mmejuputa MIT-licensed macOS nke Emanuel Perez, na Daniel Rapp's Doppler dị ka ọrụ gara aga maka ime ya na nchọgharị n'ozuzu.
sonar.explain_takeit_desc: Ngwá ọrụ na ndị na-achọpụta bụ modulu abụọ dị mfe na-enweghị 3D na DOM n'ime ha. Tụlee ha n'anya: slide deck, kiosk, embedded agent. developer reference nwere elu niile.
sonar.explain_title: Gịnị mere nke a ji arụ ọrụ
sonar.hero_lede: Ngwá ụda gị na-egwu ụda ị na-apụghị ịnụ. Aka gị na-emegharị ya, na mmegharị ahụ na-alaghachi bent: elu mgbe ị na-emegharị n'ime, ala mgbe ị na-ehichapụ. Nchegharị ahụ zuru ezu iji gụọ a sweep, a push na a lift, ma na-eme ka 3D agent dị ndụ na ha. Enweghị ihe edere, enweghi ihe na-apụ na ibe ahụ, na igwefoto na-anọchi.
sonar.hero_note: Jiri ndị na-egwu ụda na mikrofon dị n'ime, ma debe olu elu. Ekwentị na-emebi ụzọ mmegharị, ya mere, nchọpụta enweghị ihe ọ bụla iji gụọ. The carrier sits near 20 kHz: cats and dogs can hear it, ya mere kwụsị ma ọ bụrụ na anụmanụ n'ime ụlọ ahụ na-enwe nsogbu.
sonar.hero_title: Kpọọ na laptop gị. Agent gị na-aza.
sonar.link_how: Olee otú ọ si arụ ọrụ
sonar.log_count: Enweghị ihe ọ bụla ruo ugbu a
sonar.log_empty: Ihe niile mmegharị nke sensor na-achọpụta na-abata ebe a, na gụọ nke mere ya. A na-emekarị mmegharị na-ezighị ezi bụ carrier: nwalee nke ọzọ na Controls.
sonar.meta_desc: Jiri aka gị jikwaa 3D agent na-enweghị igwefoto. three.ws na-emepụta ụda na-apụghị ịnụ site na ndị na-egwu ụda gị ma na-agụ Doppler shift site na mikrofon gị, ya mere, a sweep, a push ma ọ bụ a lift na-eme ka avatar na ihuenyo.
sonar.modes_note: Mikrofon na-achọpụta anya, ọ bụghị ntụziaka, ya mere, a sweep na a push yiri ka ha na-abịa. Họrọ nke ị na-eme; All three na-arụ ọrụ na detector niile n'otu oge ma ga-emegharị na-ezighị ezi karịa.
sonar.og_desc: Kpọọ na laptop gị na agent 3D gị na-aza. Nchekwa ụda: ụda na-apụghị ịnụ si na ndị na-egwu ụda, Doppler shift na-abata site na mikrofon, enweghi igwefoto n'oge ọ bụla.
sonar.panel_signal_sub: Carrier na 600 Hz n'akụkụ ya. Ọcha bụ ụlọ kwụsiri ike. Green bụ ihe na-alaghachi ugbu a: ike na n'aka nri nke spike bụ aka na-emechi, na n'aka ekpe bụ aka na-ehichapụ.
sonar.signal_legend: ụlọ kwụsiri ike ndụ carrier
sonar.stage_error_sub: Ihe mmegharị ndị ọzọ ka na-arụ ọrụ. Sweep ọzọ ka ị gaa n'ihu.
sonar.stage_idle_sub: Pịa Start sensing, ma ọ bụ jiri njikwa keyboard iji mee ya na-enweghị mikrofon.
sonar.tw_desc: Njikwa aka maka 3D agents na-enweghị igwefoto. Ngwá ụda gị na-emepụta ụda, aka gị na-emegharị ya, avatar na-emegharị.
sonar.unsupported_h: Nke a na-emegharị na-enweghị ike ịrụ ọrụ sensor
sonar.unsupported_keyboard: Njikwa keyboard dị n'okpuru na-arụ ọrụ n'agbanyeghị, na the gesture vocabulary nwere ike ịnweta na-enweghị ngwaọrụ ọ bụla.
sonar.unsupported_reason: Nchọpụta ụda chọrọ Web Audio na mikrofon input. Safari, Chrome, Edge na Firefox na laptop niile kwadoro.
sonar.vocab_aria: Gịnị ka mmegharị ọ bụla na-eme

spatial_mcp_index.a_third_party_mcp_server_that_returns: Ihe nkesa MCP nke onye ọzọ na-eweghachi { url, previewImage } na-agbaso ụkpụrụ site na obere ihe nkwụnye — lee docs/spatial-mcp. Ihe ngosi ọ bụla na-aghọta ụdị a (nke a gụnyere) ga-egosipụta ya. Enweghị ụgwọ, akpa ego, ma ọ bụ mkpụrụ ego ọ bụla pụtara n'ụdị ma ọ bụ ihe ngosi ahụ.
spatial_mcp_index.checker_lede: Tapawa nsonaazụ ngwaọrụ n'okpuru. Otu ihe nkwenye ahụ nkọwa ahụ na-enye na-agba ọsọ na ya ka ị na-ede, na ihe nchọgharị gị, ma na-akpọ aha mpaghara a ga-edozi kama ịza ee ma ọ bụ mba. Ibu data ndị na-agbaso ụkpụrụ na-egosipụta n'okpuru; ndị na-adịghị arụ ọrụ na-enweta ihe ndabere e mere, ọ dịghị mgbe ọ bụ ihuenyo efu.

sperax.yes_the_plugin_binds_to_a_three: Ee — plugin ahụ na-ejikọta na agent three.ws, ya mere ọ chọrọ njirimara iji gosipụta. Agent ID gị bụ UUID ma ọ bụ @handle ị na-edepụta site na dashboard gị. Ị nweghị otu? Mepụta agent mbụ, wee lọghachi.

stream.how_h2: Otu esi etinye prefix na avatar zuru ezu
stream.how_p1: Packer na-eme ka mesh na-aga n'ihu, kacha mma ruo kacha njọ, ya mere, vertices na-anọgide na ọkwa ọ bụla bụ subset siri ike nke ọkwa dị n'okpuru ya. Rịba ama vertex ọ bụla site na ọkwa kacha njọ ọ na-eru, hazie vertex buffer site na nke ahụ, na vertices nke ọkwa ọ bụla na-abụ prefix na-esote. A refinement na-agbakwunye naanị byte, anaghị edepụta ha. Skinning na-agba ọsọ na-enweghị mmetọ, n'ihi na mesh simplifier na-emepụta naanị index buffer ọhụrụ n'elu vertex array e nyere ya.
stream.how_p2: N’ihi na oyi akwa 0 bụ ezigbo GLB ọ bụghịkwa blob ahaziri iche, ị nwere ike wepụ ya naanị na curl ma mepee ya na ngwaọrụ glTF ọ bụla:
stream.how_p3: Na nchọgharị, onye na-agụ na-ewe otu arịrịọ nke nwere oke na mbụ na-eme ka ọ dịkwuo mma na ndabere, na-agbanwe geometry dị na ihuenyo kama ịmepụta ọhụụ:
stream.how_p4: A na-edekọ usoro ahụ na specs/AVATAR_STREAM.md na njedebe na-enye usoro ndị a bụ /api/avatar-stream, nke ga-enye gị tebụl layer dị ka JSON.
stream.layer0_desc: Mesh kacha njọ, skeleton zuru ezu, textures thumbnail. A GLBzuru ezu n'onwe ya.
stream.layer1_desc: Vertices ọhụrụ, indices ka mma, na clips animation.
stream.layer2_desc: Geometry ọzọ, etinyere na ebe ahụ na ndụ na-ahụ.
stream.layer3_desc: Nkọwa zuru ezu na textures zuru ezu.
stream.meta_desc: A 3D avatar ekwesịghị ịbụ igbe efu ruo mgbe byte ikpeazụ rutere. A3S na-eme ka GLBn'ime layers nke mbụ 50 KB bụzi avatar zuru ezu, skinned, spec-valid, na-eme ka ọ dịkwuo mma na HTTP range requests dị mfe.
stream.share_desc: 50 KB mbụ nke A3S stream bụzi avatar zuru ezu, skinned. Lee ka ọ na-asọ mpi na GLBncheta klasiki.
stream.sub: A GLB bụ atomic: enweghị ihe na-eme ka ọ pụta ruo mgbe byte ikpeazụ rutere. Na njikọ na-adịgide adịgide, nke ahụ bụ ọtụtụ sekọnd nke ihuenyo efu na embeds ọ bụla. A3S na-emegharị otu ihe ahụ n'ime layers nested, hazie ka byte-prefix nke faịlụ ọ bụla bụ avatar zuru ezu, skinned, spec-valid. Layer mbụ bụkarị 4 ruo 17 pasent nke mbụ. Ihe niile mgbe ya na-eme ka mesh dị na ihuenyo, na Range requests nke ọ bụla CDN na-enye.

three_ws_launch_week.elevenlabs_voice_cloning_from_3_10_secon: Mkpụgharị olu ElevenLabs site na 3–10 sekọnd okwu, iwepụta àgwà site na mkparịta ụka nnabata dị mkpụmkpụ, na ịkụnye ebe nchekwa ekwenyere site na akaụntụ ejikọrọ — avatar ahụ abụghị naanị gị, onye nnọchi anya ahụ na-eme dị ka gị.
three_ws_launch_week.listed_on_the_official_model_context_pro: Edepụtara na Ndebanye aha Model Context Protocol nke gọọmentị.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_og_description: Nyiwe onye nnọchi anya AI 3D mepere emepe maka ihe nchọgharị. Izu mbụ na ọnụọgụgụ na ihe anyị butere.
three_ws_launch_week.meta_twitter_description: Ihe niile three.ws butere n'izu mwepụta — avatar 3D, ịkwụ ụgwọ onye nnọchi anya, x402 bazaar, na ihe ndị ọzọ.
three_ws_launch_week.open_source_3d_ai_agent_platform_apache: Nyiwe onye nnọchi anya AI 3D mepere emepe. Apache 2.0. Eji three.js, Claude, na nkwenye na AI kwesịrị inwe ahụ wuo ya.
three_ws_launch_week.pulled_directly_from_x_analytics_for_try: E si na nyocha X nke @trythreews nweta ya kpọmkwem n'etiti Eprel 29 na Mee 9. Enweghị nzacha, enweghị aghụghọ nkezi — ọnụọgụ isiokwu dị n'okpuru na eserese ndị ọzọ dị ala sitere n'otu nseta ihuenyo ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.reputation_markets_staking_on_agents_sig: Ahịa aha na-etinye ego na akụkọ ihe omume ndị nnọchi anya bịanyere aka na ya, EIP-7710 ụgwọ ọrụ nka a na-akwụ ndị dere nka kwa oku, na ịkwụ ụgwọ n'onwe ya site na onye nnọchi anya gaa na onye nnọchi anya site na obere akpa mbinye aka enyere ikike.
three_ws_launch_week.the_custom_element_loads_lazily_on_inter: Ihe omenala <agent-3d> na-ebunye nwayọ nwayọ mgbe ọ na-ezute, na-akwado ụdị widget ise dị iche iche (turntable, gallery animation, onye nnọchi anya na-ekwu okwu, ERC-8004 kaadị paspọtụ, njem ebe na-ekpo ọkụ), ma na-ewepụta Open Graph na oEmbed metadata ka njikọ wee gbasaa na nlele bara ụba. Widget Studio nke a na-eji pịa na-emepụta koodu ntinye a na-edegharị na /studio. Ngwugwu CDN nwere ụdị dị iche iche na-ebupụta na /agent-3d/x.y.z/.
three_ws_launch_week.the_google_cloud_announcement_was_the_si: Ọkwa Google Cloud bụ otu post kachasị nwee ntinye aka n'izu ahụ (~6.9K nlele, 263 mmasị, 24 nkesa) na akụrụngwa igwe ojii na-akwado nkeji ọzọ nke ikpo okwu ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.the_inside_the_3d_agent_web_podcast: E bipụtara ihe omume podcast “Inside The 3D Agent Web” na Amazon Music na blọọgụ ya na ya na-aga “Beyond Chatbots: Why Your AI Agent Needs a 3D Body” pụtara site na gburugburu ebe obibi Spotify-on-chain. Ebe nkesa abụọ ọzọ, otu izu ọzọ.
three_ws_launch_week.the_platform_shipped_as_a_partner_listin: E wepụtara ikpo okwu ahụ dị ka ndepụta mmekọ na Alibaba Cloud, ọwa nkesa ahịa igwe ojii mbụ anyị. Tweet mmalite ahụ metụtara ya nwetara ~7.1K nlele n'onwe ya.
three_ws_launch_week.the_roadmap_closes_the_gap_from_use: Map ụzọ ahụ na-emechi oghere site na “iji onye na-ese ihe 3D” gaa na “ịse selfie”. Nkeji anọ, akọwapụtara site na mmalite ruo na njedebe na README ọha.
three_ws_launch_week.the_runtime_drives_a_claude_tool_loop: Oge ọrụ na-akwọ ụgbọala Claude tool-loop nwere ihe ruru ugboro asatọ kwa oge na ngwaọrụ isii arụnyere n'ime (wave, lookAt, play_clip, setExpression, speak, remember). Empathy Layer abụghị igwe steeti — ọ bụ ngwakọta dị arọ na-aga n'ihu nke mmetụta ise (mmemme, nchegbu, ọchịchọ ịmata ihe, ọmịiko, ndidi), nke ọ bụla nwere ọkara ndụ ire ere nke ya, na-akwọ ụgbọala avatar’s morph targets na ọnọdụ isi kwa frame. Nka bụ ngwugwu nwere onwe ya a na-ekesa site na IPFS, Arweave, ma ọ bụ HTTP. Ebe nchekwa dabere na faịlụ nwere ụdị nchekwa anọ (mpaghara, IPFS, encrypted-IPFS, ọ dịghị).
three_ws_launch_week.the_three_ws_x_community_is_the: Obodo three.ws X bụ ndị na-ege ntị gbakọtara — ndị mmepe, ndị na-ewu ụlọ na-achọ ịmata ihe gbasara onye nnọchi anya, na otu ndị na-eso ya na-ebi ndụ. Ọ bụ ebe ebili mmiri ọzọ nke ndị nwe onye nnọchi anya ga-esi pụta.
three_ws_launch_week.three_selfies_left_center_right_gpu_back: Selfie atọ (aka ekpe, etiti, aka nri), nwughachi ihu n'ọtụtụ akụkụ nke GPU kwadoro, na avatar e mere, nke a pụrụ ime ka ọ gbaa ndụ, e mepụtara dị ka token ERC-8004 nke edemede n'ime ihe na-erughị sekọnd iri isii. Ahụmahụ njide nke ekwentị bu ụzọ na ọnụ ụzọ nyocha ogo n'ezie oge.
three_ws_launch_week.three_solidity_contracts_make_up_the_erc: Nkwekọrịta Solidity atọ mejupụtara mmejuputa ERC-8004: IdentityRegistry (token ndị nnọchi anya ERC-721 nwere ndị mbinye aka EIP-712 e nyere ikike), ReputationRegistry (nzaghachi onye nyocha abanyere aka, nke a gbakọrọ n'agbụ), na ValidationRegistry (akwụkwọ akaebe ndị nyocha maka ihe akaebe na-abụghị agbụ). Ihe omume ọ bụla speak, remember, na skill-done ka abanyere aka ma dekọọ ya. Solana na-ebuga ihe yiri ya site na iji Metaplex Core NFTs tinyere akwụkwọ akaebe SPL Memo abanyere aka — otu ụdị, ọ dịghị mmemme omenala achọrọ.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_an_open_source_browser: three.ws bụ ikpo okwu onye nnọchi anya AI 3D mepere emepe, nke ihe nchọgharị na-arụ. Anyị bugara ngwugwu zuru ezu — onye nlele, oge ọrụ onye nnọchi anya, njirimara n'agbụ, ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1, njedebe MCP, na ihe ntanetị agbakwunyere — wee lelee ka mmalite ahụ si daa. Nke a bụ ihe mere.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_organized_as_four_communicat: A haziri three.ws dị ka akwa anọ na-ekwurịta okwu, tinyere backend na ngwugwu nkwekọrịta. Akwa ọ bụla dị na mmepụta na three.ws ma na-ebuga dị ka akụkụ nke repo mepere emepe. Nke a bụ ndepụta ahụ.
three_ws_launch_week.three_ws_is_published_as_on_registry: E bipụtara three.ws dị ka io.github.nirholas/three.ws na registry.modelcontextprotocol.io ma a pụrụ ịchọta ya site na ndekọ ahọpụtara nke PulseMCP’. Onye ahịa ọ bụla maara MCP (gụnyere Claude Desktop) nwere ike jikọọ ma jikwaa avatar site na JSON-RPC.
three_ws_launch_week.vercel_functions_on_neon_postgres_cloudf: Ọrụ Vercel na Neon Postgres, Cloudflare R2, na Upstash Redis. Ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1 zuru ezu (RFC 6749 + PKCE, ndebanye aha dị ike RFC 7591, nkwụsị RFC 7009, nyocha RFC 7662, nchọpụta RFC 8414, nchọpụta akụrụngwa echekwara RFC 9728). Ihe nkesa MCP n'elu HTTP — ahịrị 759, JSON-RPC 2.0, edepụtara na Model Context Protocol Registry dị ka io.github.nirholas/three.ws. Ọrụ Cron maka ihe nchọgharị ERC-8004, EIP-7710 delegation indexer, mmejuputa atụmatụ DCA, na ndenye aha n'agbụ na-aga n'ihu.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_2_0_rendering_with_full_gltf: Ngosipụta WebGL 2.0 na nkwado zuru ezu nke glTF 2.0 / GLB: mkpakọ geometry Draco, mkpakọ texture KTX2, njikarịcha mesh Meshopt, map gburugburu ebe obibi HDR, ihe PBR, animation akpụkpọ anụ, morph targets, na igwefoto agbakwunyere. Nkwenye bụ ọkwa ahịrị site na Khronos gltf-validator. Nbudata site na ịdọrọ na idobe, OrbitControls nwere ntụgharị akpaaka a pụrụ ịhazi, na dat.GUI n'ezie oge maka mgbanwe dị ndụ.
three_ws_launch_week.webgl_viewer_llm_agent_runtime_erc_8004: Onye nlele WebGL, oge ọrụ onye nnọchi anya LLM, nkwekọrịta njirimara ERC-8004, ihe nkesa OAuth 2.1, njedebe MCP, na ihe ntanetị <agent-3d> — ihe niile ị gụrụ banyere ya n'elu. Dị ndụ na three.ws taa.

trading.fleet_vitals_sub: Gụọ ya ozugbo site n'aka onye ọrụ na-arụ ọrụ. Ọ bụrụ na nọmba ebe a adịghị ọhụrụ, ụgbọ mmiri ahụ adịghị ọhụrụ.
trading.hero_sub: Otu ìgwè ndị ọrụ AI na-azụ ahịa mkpụrụ ego ọhụrụ sitere na obere akpa Solana nke ha, n'okpuru iwu ha na-enweghị ike ịgbanahụ. A na-enye ntinye ọ bụla akara, a na-atụle ọnọdụ ọ bụla megide mmefu ego dị oke egwu, ma onye ọrụ n'onwe ya na-eji igodo ya abanye n'ụzọ zuru ezu ma nwee ike ịlele ya na chain. Ibe a bụ ụlọ njikwa: ihe ụgbọ mmiri ahụ na-eme ugbu a, otu o si ekpebi, na ebe ọ ga-aga ọzọ.
trading.meta_description: Ụlọ njikwa maka azụmahịa akpaaka three.ws: ọnọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ndụ, bọọdụ akara onye nnọchi anya, usoro ntinye-ịpụ zuru oke, na ebe azụmahịa niile n'otu ebe. Akpa ego n'ezie, njuputa n'ezie, enwere ike nyochaa ya na chain.
trading.meta_og_description: Ọnọdụ ụgbọ mmiri dị ndụ, bọọdụ akara onye nnọchi anya, na ebe azụmahịa akpaaka niile n'otu ebe.

trading.pipeline_sub: Ntinye ọ bụla na-agafe n'otu ọnụ ụzọ ámá ahụ, n'usoro a. Ọnụ ụzọ ámá na-enweghị ike igosi na mkpụrụ ego dị mma na-egbochi azụmahịa ahụ kama ịkọ nkọ.
trading.rail_budget_body: Oke azụmahịa ọ bụla, mmefu kwa ụbọchị, na ọnụ ọgụgụ kachasị elu nke ọnọdụ n'otu oge bụ oke a na-enyocha tupu mgbasa ozi ọ bụla.
trading.rail_custody_body: Ndị nnọchi anya na-eji igodo nke ha azụ ahịa site na ụzọ nchekwa a nyochara. Gụọ ụdị nchekwa ahụ.
trading.rail_kill_body: N'ụwa niile na maka onye nnọchi anya ọ bụla. Ịgbanwe ya na-akwụsị ntinye ọhụrụ ozugbo, ma onye nwe ya nwere ike ịwepụ akpa ego mgbe niile.
trading.rail_moonbag: Agaghị ewepụta ihe niile na onye mmeri
trading.rail_moonbag_body: Iwu ụgbọ mmiri na-edebe obere òkè nke ọnọdụ mmeri site na nhazi, ya mere, a pụghị ire ezigbo oku kpamkpam n'oge.
trading.rail_risk_body: Ịzụ ahịa mkpụrụ ego ọhụrụ ewepụtara nwere ike ime ka ị tụfuo ọnọdụ ahụ dum. Gụọ nkwenye ihe ize ndụ tupu ịkwadebe ihe ọ bụla.
trading.rail_stop_body: Atụmatụ a kwadebere ọ bụla na-ebu nkwụsị-mfu, nke mmachi nchekwa data na-eme ka ọ dị irè. Atụmatụ na-enweghị ya enweghị ike ịdị.
trading.safety_rails_sub: A na-eme ka ndị a dị irè na koodu na na nchekwa data, ọ bụghị na ngwa ngwa. Onye nnọchi anya enweghị ike ịrụ ụka gafere nke ọ bụla n'ime ha.
trading.scoreboard_sub: Uru na mfu a ghọtara kwa onye nnọchi anya, naanị azụmahịa emechiri emechi. A naghị agụ ọnọdụ mepere emepe dị ka uru.
trading.step_exit_body: N'ihe dị ka okpukpu abụọ nke ntinye, onye nnọchi anya na-ere ihe zuru oke iji nwetaghachi òkè ya ma debe ihe fọdụrụ dị ka akpa ọnwa na nkwụsị na-eso. Nkwụsị-mfu siri ike na-emeri esemokwu ọ bụla, na nkwụsị oge na-emechi ihe ọ bụla na-agaghị ebe ọ bụla.
trading.step_firewall_body: A na-eme ka njem ịzụta na ire ere n'ezie na chain tupu mgbasa ozi ọ bụla. Ọ bụrụ na ire ere ahụ laghachi azụ, a pụghị ịpụ na mkpụrụ ego ahụ ma gbochie azụmahịa ahụ. A na-enyocha ikike ịmepụta na ifriizi n'otu ngafe ahụ.
trading.step_score_body: A na-enyocha mkpụrụ ego ahụ dabere na oke ahịa, akụkọ ihe mere eme onye okike, mgbasa ozi mmekọrịta na akụrụngwa nkwuputa. Ụfọdụ ndị nnọchi anya na-agba iwu edoziri, ndị ọzọ na-enyefe mkpebi ahụ na ihe nlereanya asụsụ, na bọọdụ akara dị n'elu bụ ihe na-edozi esemokwu ahụ.
trading.step_signal_body: Mwepụta, nkwupụta ụgwọ mbụ, ngafe oracle, ma ọ bụ ngụsị akwụkwọ na-adaba na nri. Onye ọrụ na-emepe nri ahụ, ya mere ọ na-emeghachi omume n'otu sekọnd ahụ kama ịbụ na usoro ihe omume.
trading.step_size_body: Oke ọnọdụ na-esi na mmefu ego onye nnọchi anya kwa azụmahịa, nke mmefu ego ya kwa ụbọchị na oke ọnọdụ mepere emepe na-egbochi. Nchekwa mmefu na iwu akpa ego na-eme ka ọ dị irè na koodu, ya mere ọ nweghị nhazi nwere ike ime ka ha gbasaa.

tty.card2_desc: Joint matrices na-enyocha kwa frame ma na-ejikọta kwa vertex, ya mere, avatar a na-emegharị na-emegharị akụkụ ya. Ọ bụghị mesh static na-agba.
tty.card3_desc: Ogologo igwefoto bụ nke a na-emezi site na frame kachasị ukwuu nke clip na etiti na-eso ọnọdụ, ya mere, usoro ije na mgbakwunye na-adịghị anwụ anwụ ma ọ bụ na-apụ na shot.
tty.card4_desc: Ihu ọkụ, a na-ejikwa ya, na rim term. Na nguzogide a, mbipụta na-ejide ụdị, ya mere, ihu na-atụfu na-ebuli kama ịkpụ na ojii.
tty.cmd_note: Na-arụ ọrụ na terminal ọ bụla nke na-emegharị agba. Pịa Ctrl-C iji kwụsị ya.
tty.demo_h: Nke a bụ mmepụta ziri ezi
tty.demo_p: Ọ bụghị vidiyo ma ọ bụ ndekọ. Panel dị n'okpuru na-emeghe otu HTTP stream curl ga-eme, na-ese ihe ndị na-apụ apụ nke ọ na-enweta.
tty.endpoint_p: GET /api/tty na-agba frames dịka text/plain, na-emegharị na oge ziri ezi, ya mere, nzaghachi n'onwe ya bụ animation. Ọ bụla parameter bụ nhọrọ.
tty.eyebrow: enweghị gpu · enweghị webgl · enweghị nrụnye
tty.hero_lede: Otu iwu. A na-ebudata 3D character a na-emegharị, na-egwu animation ya, na-agba na turntable, nke a na-ese n'ozuzu site na ederede agba. Enweghị ihe ọ bụla a ga-emepụta ma ọ bụ na-agba: a na-emegharị frames na sava anyị ma na-ebufe ha na shell gị ka ha na-ese.
tty.meta_desc: curl three.ws/tty na avatar 3D a na-emegharị na-eje ije na terminal gị. A na-emegharị software rasterizer na-ebufe ANSI frames site na HTTP: enweghi GPU, enweghi WebGL, enweghi nrụnye. Na mgbakwunye @three-ws/tty-3d, CLI na SDK nke na-emegharị GLB ọ bụla na terminal.
tty.note: Ndị nchọgharị na-arịọ URL a na-eziga ebe a kama, n'ihi na nchọgharị ga-egosi koodu mwepụ dịka ihe mkpofu. Zipu ?raw=1 ka ị hụ byte ndị ahụ n'agbanyeghị.
tty.page_title: Agente gị, na terminal gị · three.ws
tty.render_keys: Igodo ntụgharị, w/s tilting, +/- zoom, oghere na-ejide, q na-akwụsị.
tty.render_p: Renderer bụ ngwugwu e bipụtara. Ọ na-ewe GLB, na-eme ka ọ bụrụ nke a na-aghọta (gụnyere EXT_meshopt_compression, nke ọtụtụ avatars zụtara na ya), na-enyocha animation, na-etinye linear blend skinning na CPU, ma na-eme rasterization na z-buffer. Enweghị GPU na-ejikọta na ya n'oge ọ bụla, ya mere, ọ na-arụ ọrụ otu a na SSH, na CI, ma ọ bụ na akpa na-enweghị ngosi.

tty.row_frames_meaning: Olee ọtụtụ frames ka e zigara. 1 na-enye otu.
tty.row_spin_meaning: Ọsọ turntable na radians kwa nkeji. 0 na-ejide.
tty.row_t_meaning: Ebee ka clip ga-amalite, na sekọnd.
